subsections.text_before_clauses: The service of a notice, or summon, or requisition, or order, or any other communication, under this Act (herein referred to as communication) may be made by delivering or transmitting a copy thereof, to the person therein named—

clauses.text: by post or by such courier services as may be approved by the Board;
in such manner as provided under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908) for the purposes of service of summons;
in the form of any electronic record as provided in Chapter IV of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000); or
by any other means of transmission of documents, as may be prescribed.

subsections.text_before_clauses: The Board may make rules providing for the addresses (including the address for electronic mail or electronic mail message) to which the communication referred to in sub-section (1) may be delivered or transmitted to the person therein named.

For the purposes of this section, "electronic mail" and "electronic mail message" means a message or information created or transmitted or received on a computer, computer system, computer resource or communication device including attachments in text, image, audio, video and any other electronic record, which may be transmitted with the message.
